mapper.sql: r.id, r.file_name, r.source_sha256, r.source_bytes, r.source_characters, r.item_id, r.version_id, v.title, k.status AS item_status, r.create_copy, r.created_at
knowledge_text_import r JOIN knowledge_item k ON k.owner_id=r.owner_id AND k.id=r.item_id JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=r.owner_id AND v.item_id=r.item_id AND v.id=r.version_id
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_text_import WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_sha256=#{sha256})
SELECT FROM WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_text_import (id, owner_id, file_name, source_sha256, source_bytes, source_characters, item_id, version_id, create_copy, created_at) VALUES (#{entry.id}, #{owner}, #{entry.fileName}, #{entry.sourceSha256}, #{entry.sourceBytes}, #{entry.sourceCharacters}, #{entry.itemId}, #{entry.versionId}, #{entry.createCopy}, #{entry.createdAt})
